## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Booking
where: BookingRepository (uses), src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts, component persistence

=====SOURCE-BEGIN

=====SOURCE-END=====

### B

.filter((c) => c.start < session.end && session.start < c.end);
=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: These are different concepts stored in separate repositories. SessionService (node 42a26b41b626f9ec, src/business/sessionService.ts) calls both BookingRepository.findBySession and ClubBookingRepository.findByDate. A Booking is a per-session reservation held by an individual: it is looked up by session and handled by handlePaymentResult and notifyHolders. A Club Booking is a block of time with its own start and end, which the code checks for overlap with sessions: `.filter((c) => c.start < session.end && session.start < c.end);`. It affects session availability rather than being a reservation within a session. The names overlap, but the real-world things differ.
